messages:
nina_sales: Quick heads-up Greenline Legal (emily@greenline.com) asked for SOC2/ISO artifacts + a signed pen-test attestation for the POC. They want docs by EOD Fri. Can we deliver?

samsec: We can provide a pen-test attestation letter signed by VP Security and a redacted SOC 2 report. For ISO they asked for an artifacts list (SoA, cert if available, key policies). Need to confirm they only need hosted API scope.

eli_engineer: Confirming hosted API only. No private/dedicated infra in scope. Also note: pen-test vendor reports contain vuln details; we never share raw reports without escalation. We give an attestation letter that confirms testing occurred and remediation posture.

maria_pm: Action plan: (1) nina confirm legal entity/address for signature block; (2) samsec will prepare attestation draft; (3) compliance team will prepare redacted SOC2 if requested. If they ask for ISO certificate and we don't have it, we will provide SoA and policy excerpts.

nina_sales: Entity: Greenline Technologies, Inc., 240 Market St, Suite 900, San Francisco, CA 94105. Emily said redacted SOC2 is fine but wants to know what fields are redacted. I'll ask.

compliance_bot: Reminder: SOC2 redaction process requires ticket to compliance@redwood.com. Expected turnaround 1 business day for standard redaction. Pen-test attestation template located at https://internal/docs/security/pen-test-attest-v1.pdf (access restricted).

samsec: Drafted attestation and populating details now. Will request VP signature. If Greenline wants vendor name or testing dates, we can include month/year but will not include detailed findings.

eli_engineer: Also flag: if they request an unredacted SOC2 or full pen-test report, that requires signed NDA and legal approval. Tell Emily up front to avoid surprises.

nina_sales: Got it. I told Emily: we'll provide attestation + redacted SOC2; unredacted reports require NDA. She replied with a time preference: "as soon as possible but by Friday is fine". I'll follow up once I get confirmation on redaction fields.

maria_pm: For POC commercial terms: keep pricing/credits separate thread. If they later request extended SLA during POC, escalate to sales_ops.

samsec: I'll post the signed PDF here when it's signed. Expect within business hours today once VP approves.

nina_sales: Thanks all, I'll update once Emily replies about redaction specifics.
